literal_meaning: চালানোর পরস্পর আদান-প্রদান (sending back and forth)
figurative_meaning_en: synonymous words; mutual exchange; give and take
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়িক চুক্তির জন্য দলগুলোর মধ্যে চালাচালি হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Correspondence with the prospective in-laws is ongoing.
Negotiations are going back and forth between the business parties.
note: Commonly used in contexts of arranged marriages and negotiations in Bengali culture.
